plan.notes: Source: official 'B.S. in Computer Science - RCEAS Sample Course Sequence (Class 2023 or Later)' page, P.C. Rossin College of Engineering & Applied Science, Lehigh University (https://engineering.lehigh.edu/cse/bs-cs-rceas-sample-course-sequence-class-2023-or-later), the genuine official term-by-term suggested sequence for the Bachelor of Science in Computer Science through the P.C. Rossin College of Engineering and Applied Science. Cross-checked against the official program requirements page (https://engineering.lehigh.edu/cse/academics/undergraduate/computer-science-bs-rossin-college-engineering/bs-computer-science-rceas, 'Total required credit hours: 130') and the Lehigh University 2026-27 catalog PDF (https://catalog.lehigh.edu/coursesprogramsandcurricula/engineeringandappliedscience/computerscienceandengineering/computerscienceandengineering.pdf), which lists the EN-BS Computer Science program at 'Total required credit hours: 130' / 'Total Credits 130-131'. Hand-transcribed 2026-09-30 from the official page text; nothing invented. Transcribed sequence sums to exactly 130 credits = the program's published total. CAVEATS: (1) The sample sequence page labels CSE 281 Capstone Project II at 2 credits and ENGR 010 Applied Engineering Computer Methods at 2 credits; the 2026-27 catalog lists CSE 281 at 3 credits and ENGR 010 at 3 credits. The sequence is transcribed as published. (2) The 2026-27 catalog reorganized some requirements (WRT 001/002 academic writing in place of ENGL 001/002 composition, a 12-credit 'Natural World' science block); the official sample sequence follows the Class of 2023+ arrangement (ENGL 001/002, MATH 023, PHY 021/022 listed explicitly). (3) Elective chunks ('HSS electives, approved electives, or free electives') are student choice; each is modeled as one choice slot carrying the chunk's full credit value per the official sequence. (4) CSE 007 slot honors the catalog's approved alternative: CSE 003 (2 cr) + CSE 004 (2 cr) OR CSE 007 (4 cr). (5) Prereqs intentionally left empty — the sequence page does not publish per-course prerequisites; none were invented. (6) The sequence page carries the historical footnote: 'CSE 140 = CSE 198 (Spring 2018 only) or CSE 261 (Fall 2017 or earlier)'. (7) This is the RCEAS (engineering) BS program, ABET-accredited; Lehigh also offers a separate BS in Computer Science through the College of Arts and Sciences, which is NOT this plan.
